description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets per year for the paper “The Unseen Targets of Hate — A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” with bars colored by language category as indicated in the legend titled “Languages.” The horizontal axis contains the categories and is labeled “Year,” showing years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks labeled at approximately \(10^1\) and \(10^2\) (about 10 and 100), spanning from near 1 up to a bit above 100. For each year, one or more vertical bars appear: blue bars (legend label “1”) are present from 2012 through 2021 and rise from about 2 datasets in 2012 and 2013, to about 3 in 2014 and 2015, about 12 in 2016, about 20 in 2017, about 45 in 2018, about 60 in 2019, about 100 in 2020, and about 130 in 2021. Orange bars (second legend entry) appear from 2017 onward with approximate values of about 5 in 2017, about 2 in 2018, about 7 in 2019, about 20 in 2020, and about 10 in 2021, plus a small orange bar in 2022 at about 2. In 2022, there is also a light-blue bar (not shown as a separate legend entry in the visible legend) at roughly 30 datasets. The bars are not displayed as side-by-side grouped pairs for every year (some years show only one bar), and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color coding; the years themselves are ordered chronologically rather than sorted by bar height.
